method: Actual engine captures, 960x640 DPR1 (mobile 390x844). Same absolute camera assertions per scene; January Overcast used to inspect 0/.18/.85 coating with precipitation stopped. Wind and sun matched to 15A; clouds intentionally change. Fixed snowCover is explicit diagnostic, not natural instant accumulation. Bridge and underneath are separate diagnostic viewpoints at documented comparison altitudes, not a continuous walk. UI controls hidden only for comparison images.
